Class UriParameterRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<Object>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.UriParameterRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<Object>
Direct Known Subclasses:
PathParameterRenderer
public class UriParameterRenderer extends AbstractParameterRenderer<Object>
A specialized parameter renderer for an individual URI string.

Supports both a compact pill/chip representation and an in-place high-fidelity text editor for modifying or removing the URI. When placed inside a collection, it is composed by a list container such as WrapListParameterRenderer or VBoxListParameterRenderer.

anahata
